excerpt: Everyone, please keep in mind that the person reviewing your paperwork is reviewing document after document of different people, all day long. In your intro letter, I think it would be a good idea to explain why your claim is covered by the PACT act. Include a copy of any relevant paperwork (like DD214) or other documents that would prove you were over there. this is a simple administrative mistake and if you ask for your claim to be reviewed it will be caught by a HLR, but save yourself some time and include clear instructions to the reader as to why your claim is covered under the PACT act! If you do have a denial due to no service connection, simply ask them to review the claim and include this information so they will ensure it's marked as service connected.
